apply_effect.definition: CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_upsert_nothing FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION upsert_nothing()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_empty_sql FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION empty_sql()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_return_old FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION return_old()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_return_null FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION return_null()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_bad_end FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION bad_end()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_bad_return FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION bad_return()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_short_body FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION short_body()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_no_begin FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION no_begin()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_no_return FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION no_return()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_unsupported_language FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION unsupported_language()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_invalid_sql FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION invalid_sql()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_derived_update FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION derived_update()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_derived_delete FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION derived_delete()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_ambiguous EXECUTE FUNCTION overloaded()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_missing_body EXECUTE FUNCTION missing_body()
CREATE TRIGGER apply_effect AFTER INSERT ON source_missing_function EXECUTE FUNCTION absent()

upsert_nothing().definition: CREATE FUNCTION upsert_nothing() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT 1; INSERT INTO audit (id) VALUES (1) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING; $$

empty_sql().definition: CREATE FUNCTION empty_sql() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$  $$

return_old().definition: CREATE FUNCTION return_old() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN OLD; END; $$

return_null().definition: CREATE FUNCTION return_null() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ begin return null; end; $$

bad_end().definition: CREATE FUNCTION bad_end() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET value = 1; RETURN NEW; FINISH; $$

bad_return().definition: CREATE FUNCTION bad_return() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET value = 1; RETURN something_else; END; $$

short_body().definition: CREATE FUNCTION short_body() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN $$

no_begin().definition: CREATE FUNCTION no_begin() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE x int; BEGIN RETURN NEW; END; $$

no_return().definition: CREATE FUNCTION no_return() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN UPDATE accounts SET value = 1; END; $$

unsupported_language().definition: CREATE FUNCTION unsupported_language() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpython3u AS $$ UPDATE accounts SET value = 1; $$

invalid_sql().definition: CREATE FUNCTION invalid_sql() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE accounts SET $$

derived_update().definition: CREATE FUNCTION derived_update() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE (SELECT * FROM accounts) AS a SET value = 1; $$

derived_delete().definition: CREATE FUNCTION derived_delete() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$ DELETE FROM (SELECT * FROM accounts) AS a; $$

overloaded().definition: CREATE FUNCTION overloaded() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE accounts SET value = 1; $$

overloaded(integer).definition: CREATE FUNCTION overloaded(integer) RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE accounts SET value = 2; $$

missing_body().definition: CREATE FUNCTION missing_body() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE sql
